create_multiple_input_mapping: create a MultipleInputMapping instance from a model config AttrDict to map inputs to model heads
parse_mapping_entry: parse a single mapping entry with legacy list format or flexible dict format for input-to-head assignment
add_input_key: add an input key to the mapping while validating against duplicate keys
build_multi_head_config: build a multi-input multi-head model configuration using feat_names, head_index, and additional_keys mappings
review_multiple_input_mapping: review the MultipleInputMapping dataclass that maps multiple inputs to different parts of a model
